questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He is senior than me in service."
questions.explanation: Rule: Senior के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'to' आता है (senior to me).

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Neither Ram nor his friends is present today."
questions.explanation: Rule: Neither...nor में निकटतम सब्जेक्ट ('friends' प्लुरल) के अनुसार Plural Verb 'are' आएगी।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "She has been waiting here since two hours."
questions.explanation: Rule: अवधि ('two hours') के लिए प्रपोजिशन 'for' आता है (for two hours).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He congratulated me _____ my grand success."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Congratulate' के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'on' आता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She prefers coffee _____ tea in winter."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Prefer' के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'to' आता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He was accused _____ theft by the police."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Accuse' के साथ हमेशा 'of' आता है (accused of theft).

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "Hardly had I entered <u>when</u> the phone rang."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Hardly' के साथ कंजंक्शन 'when' बिल्कुल सही है (No improvement).

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "If I <u>was</u> you, I would fly."
questions.explanation: Rule: काल्पनिक वाक्य में Subject के साथ 'were' आता है।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "He wrote a letter."
options: A letter was being written by him.
A letter has been written by him.
A letter is written by him.
A letter was written by him.
questions.explanation: Past Simple का Passive = Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "They are playing cricket."
options: Cricket is being played by them.
Cricket has been played by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous का Passive = Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said, "I am going to market."
options: He said that he was going to market.
He said that I am going to market.
He asked if he was going to market.
He told that he is going to market.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous बदलकर Past Continuous (was going) बनता है।

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: She said to me, "What is your name?"
options: She told me what my name is.
She asked me what is my name.
She asked me what was my name.
She asked me what my name was.
questions.explanation: WH- question का Indirect = asked + me + what my name was.
